audit.whatIsWrong: Row 4 gave level 6 to Ziggs at 3/10 while whys[4] beside it says "his R is global waveclear, useless in the duel you dictate" and spikes[1].text says the ultimate "does nothing to you in lane". The packet chart also gives that row to Yasuo.
audit.why: Mega Inferno Bomb is a 5000-range zone tool, not a duel spell; nothing about level 6 hands Ziggs the lane. Every other row already agreed with the packet.
audit.corrected: Row 4 flipped in BOTH layers as one paired edit with its rating, and phases[4].why rewritten to say why the stage stays yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: No stage carried a cooldown, so "engage when Satchel Charge is down" had no timer.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s, Bouncing Bomb 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s, Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70s, and your own Wind Wall 25s at rank 1 for 4 seconds of uptime. The 20s W against your 4s wall is the actual engage arithmetic.
audit.corrected: The rank-1 numbers written into spikes[0].text, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Wind Wall blocks Satchel Charge — in spikes[0].text, mid and the dosFull[2] title. Satchel Charge carries no projectile flag and Riot's text describes a flung charge that detonates after a delay, knocking enemies away; the wall destroys projectiles. Bouncing Bomb and Mega Inferno Bomb ARE the projectiles, and Satchel Charge deals a percentage of maximum health, so armour misreads it. Short Fuse's auto-attack reset is also unmentioned.
audit.why: Telling the reader their 25-second wall answers his 20-second displacement means they will dash in expecting to be safe and get knocked out of their own engage. missingInteractions flags both the max-health rule and the Short Fuse reset.
audit.corrected: The Satchel Charge claims replaced with the real split — wall the bombs, time the dash for after his W; dosFull[2] re-titled and re-keyed; dontsFull[0].d gives the max-health knockback and its 20s; dosFull[1].d gives the Short Fuse tell.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ziggs's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Mega Inferno Bomb is waveclear, not a duel tool — at 6 you still dictate, and Last Breath needs him Airborne first.

edits.before: Once you have E you close the gap Ziggs relies on — Wind Wall eats his Bouncing Bomb (Q) poke and his Satchel Charge (W) displacement, and your dash chains through minions to get on top of him. Every time his Q is down, walk him down.
edits.after: Once you have E you close the gap Ziggs relies on — Wind Wall eats Bouncing Bomb (Q, 6s at rank 1) but not the Satchel Charge knockback, so time the dash for after his W. Every time his Q is down, walk him down and make him spend it.

edits.before: From level 2-3 the lane flips to you — once E is online you gap-close off minions, Wind Wall his Q and W, and punish every poke cooldown. He has no reliable disengage but Satchel's self-knockback, which you bait and then dash after. Keep the wave pushing so you always have minions to E through and run him down.
edits.after: From level 2-3 the lane flips to you — once E is online you gap-close off minions, wall his Bouncing Bomb, and punish every poke cooldown. His only disengage is Satchel's self-knockback, which the wall does not stop, so bait it and then dash after him. Keep the wave pushing so you always have minions to E through.

edits.before: Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Q and his R are projectiles; Satchel Charge is not — wall the bombs.

edits.before: Dash through the wave stacking Q, tag Ziggs with Q2, and only commit the EQ3 knockup when his answer is down.
edits.after: Short Fuse resets his auto after every spell — the wind-up is the tell; stack Q through the wave and step out.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: It knocks you away and deals max-health damage — 20s at rank 1, wait it out.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: It is 25s at rank 1 for 4 seconds — spend it on his commit.

notes: No mirror existed; this page sets the shape ziggs__yasuo must invert (Ziggs level 1 only, Yasuo rows 1-6 with row 1 as Skill). Main correction: Wind Wall blocks Bouncing Bomb and Mega Inferno Bomb, both flagged projectiles, but NOT Satchel Charge, which the page claimed in three places. Not asserted: whether Wind Wall's terrain component interacts with Hexplosive Minefield's mines — the mines carry no projectile flag and nothing in the data covers ground-placed zones.
